files.name: Medication Reconciliation Policy — Draft Rev 3.docx
files.summary: Draft revision 3 of the network medication-reconciliation policy, adopted in principle by the Quality Steering Committee on 10-JUN. Requires a documented reconciliation at every transition of care (admission, transfer, discharge). Pending workflow update (David Munoz) and compliance review (Priya Raman) before publication.
files.content_excerpt: Section 2 Scope: medication reconciliation shall be performed and documented at every transition of care across all network clinics. Section 5 Responsibility: clinic operations leads ensure workflow compliance; Quality audits adherence quarterly.

files.name: MediTech Biomedical — MSA & SLA Schedule.pdf
files.summary: Master Service Agreement and SLA schedule with MediTech Biomedical Inc. Covers biomedical equipment preventive maintenance, calibration, and emergency repair across all Northbridge clinics. SLA: 48-hour response for preventive maintenance, 4-hour response for critical equipment failure. Service credit: 10% of monthly fee per SLA breach. Auto-renewal 01-SEP annually with 60-day notice to terminate.
files.content_excerpt: Section 3 Scope: preventive maintenance and calibration for all biomedical equipment per FDA and Joint Commission standards. Section 7 SLA: 48h response for scheduled maintenance; 4h response for critical equipment (defibrillators, ventilators). Section 8 Service Credits: 10% of monthly fee per calendar month with an SLA breach.

files.name: PharmaLink — Distribution Agreement.pdf
files.summary: Distribution agreement with PharmaLink Distributors for clinical supplies and pharmacy distribution. Covers formulary kits, PPE, and controlled-substance audit materials. SLA: 5-business-day delivery for standard orders, 24-hour delivery for urgent orders. Service credit clause 5.2: 5% credit per week of delay on any line item. Renewal 15-OCT annually.
files.content_excerpt: Section 2 Scope: distribution of formulary kits, PPE supplies, and controlled-substance record-keeping materials. Section 5.2 Service Credits: 5% of delayed line-item value per week of delay beyond the committed delivery date. Section 9 Renewal: annual renewal on 15-OCT with 90-day rebid notice.

files.name: ClearPoint — Clinical Software License & Support Agreement.pdf
files.summary: License and support agreement with ClearPoint Clinical Solutions for CPOE, lab-order interface, and clinical decision support software. Covers the medication-interaction alerting module required for Joint Commission medication-management compliance. SLA: 99.5% uptime, 2-hour P1 incident response. Appendix C maps features to Joint Commission standards. Renewal 01-MAR-2027.
files.content_excerpt: Section 1 Scope: CPOE module, lab-order HL7 interface, and medication-interaction alerting (clinical decision support). Appendix C: feature-to-standard mapping for Joint Commission medication-management requirements. Section 6 SLA: 99.5% monthly uptime; 2h P1 response, 8h P2 response. Section 10 Renewal: 01-MAR-2027, 120-day notice.

files.name: VirtuCare Health — Telehealth Platform Proposal.pdf
files.summary: VirtuCare Health proposal for RFP-001 (Telehealth Platform). Annual cost $185K, 3-year TCO $520K. Full LuminaEHR HL7/FHIR integration, e-prescribing included, mobile apps, 99.9% uptime SLA, 2h P1 response, SOC 2 Type II certified. 200+ healthcare clients. 8-week implementation. References: Cascade Health Network, Pinnacle Medical Group.
files.content_excerpt: Pricing: $185,000/year, $60,000 one-time implementation fee. Integration: native HL7/FHIR connector for LuminaEHR (pre-built, tested at 12 sites). SLA: 99.9% uptime, 2-hour P1 response, 24/7 support. Compliance: HIPAA, SOC 2 Type II (audited annually), BAA provided. Implementation: 8-week phased rollout — Week 1-2 configuration, Week 3-5 integration testing, Week 6-7 training, Week 8 go-live. References: Cascade Health (18 clinics, 2 years), Pinnacle Medical (8 clinics, 3 years).

files.name: TeleMedix Solutions — Telehealth Platform Proposal.pdf
files.summary: TeleMedix Solutions proposal for RFP-001 (Telehealth Platform). Annual cost $210K, 3-year TCO $595K. Native LuminaEHR connector (deployed at 8 Lumina sites), HITRUST certified, DEA-compliant e-prescribing, 99.95% uptime SLA, 1h P1 response. 500+ clients, 10 years in healthcare. 12-week implementation with onsite team. References: Regional Health Partners, Great Lakes Medical Center.
files.content_excerpt: Pricing: $210,000/year, $55,000 implementation + onsite training. Integration: pre-built LuminaEHR connector (live at 8 Lumina client sites). SLA: 99.95% uptime guaranteed, 1-hour P1 response (contractual, with service credits). Compliance: HIPAA, SOC 2 Type II, HITRUST CSF certified, DEA-compliant EPCS. Implementation: 12-week with dedicated onsite team — includes train-the-trainer program. Client base: 500+ healthcare organizations, 50+ multi-site networks. References: Regional Health Partners (32 clinics), Great Lakes Medical Center (15 clinics), Beacon Health Alliance (22 clinics).

files.name: HealthBridge Connect — Telehealth Platform Proposal.pdf
files.summary: HealthBridge Connect proposal for RFP-001 (Telehealth Platform). Annual cost $125K ($140K with e-prescribing add-on), 3-year TCO $340K. AI-powered clinical triage, REST/FHIR EHR integration (LuminaEHR connector not pre-built — estimated 4 weeks custom development). SOC 2 Type II in progress (expected Q4 2026). 45 clients (founded 2023). 6-week remote implementation. 99.5% uptime SLA, 4h P1 response.
files.content_excerpt: Pricing: $125,000/year (base), e-prescribing via DrFirst add-on $15,000/year. No implementation fee for early-adopter partners. Integration: REST/FHIR API — LuminaEHR requires custom connector (4 weeks estimated development). SLA: 99.5% uptime, 4-hour P1 response. Compliance: HIPAA compliant, SOC 2 Type II audit in progress (completion expected Q4 2026). Differentiator: AI-powered symptom triage reduces unnecessary in-person visits by 30% (validated across 12 pilot sites). Founded 2023, 45 clients, 3x year-over-year growth.

files.name: Meridian Data Sciences — Clinical Analytics Proposal.pdf
files.summary: Meridian Data Sciences proposal for RFP-002 (Clinical Analytics). Annual cost $165K, 3-year TCO $460K. Enterprise analytics with native HL7/FHIR connectors for LuminaEHR and ClearPoint CPOE. 12 pre-built Joint Commission report templates. Real-time dashboards, population health analytics, predictive modeling. 50+ hospital deployments. SOC 2 Type II, HITRUST. 10-week implementation. 99.9% uptime SLA.
files.content_excerpt: Pricing: $165,000/year, $35,000 implementation fee. Integration: pre-built HL7/FHIR connectors for LuminaEHR and ClearPoint CPOE (tested and deployed at 8 joint clients). Joint Commission: 12 standard report templates covering all required quality metrics, customizable. Analytics: real-time dashboards (15+ standard views), population health trending, predictive readmission risk scoring. SLA: 99.9% uptime, dedicated support engineer. References: Midwest Health System (22 sites, 4 years), Atlantic Regional Medical (12 sites, 2 years).

files.name: InsightHealth Analytics — Clinical Analytics Proposal.pdf
files.summary: InsightHealth Analytics proposal for RFP-002 (Clinical Analytics). Annual cost $130K, 3-year TCO $365K. Cloud-native, zero on-premise infrastructure. FHIR-based EHR integration (LuminaEHR connector available, ClearPoint requires 3 weeks custom work). 8 of 12 Joint Commission report templates available (remaining 4 in Q1 2027 roadmap). Real-time dashboards, predictive analytics. SOC 2 Type II certified. 6-week implementation. 99.5% uptime SLA. 30 healthcare clients.
files.content_excerpt: Pricing: $130,000/year, $15,000 implementation (cloud setup + training). Integration: FHIR-native — LuminaEHR connector ready, ClearPoint CPOE connector requires 3 weeks of custom integration. Joint Commission: 8 of 12 standard report templates available today; remaining 4 (environment-of-care, credentialing metrics, medication-management variance, sentinel-event trending) on product roadmap for Q1 2027. SLA: 99.5% uptime, 4-hour P1, 8-hour P2. References: Coastal Health Group (10 sites), Metro Ambulatory Network (6 sites).

files.name: EnviroMed Disposal — Medical Waste Management Proposal.pdf
files.summary: EnviroMed Disposal proposal for RFP-003 (Medical Waste Management). Annual cost $82K. 15 years in healthcare waste. DOT-certified fleet, EPA compliant. 3x/week scheduled pickups, 4-hour emergency collection. Online manifesting/tracking portal. Pharmaceutical waste handling (DEA-compliant). Staff OSHA compliance training included. 150+ healthcare facility clients.
files.content_excerpt: Pricing: $82,000/year, all Northbridge facilities included. Service: 3x/week scheduled pickups at all sites, 4-hour emergency collection response. Fleet: DOT-certified, GPS-tracked vehicles, EPA-compliant processing at owned facility. Pharmaceutical waste: in-house DEA-compliant destruction with chain-of-custody manifesting. Training: annual OSHA compliance training for all designated staff. Portal: real-time tracking, manifesting, compliance audit reports. References: Lakewood Health System (12 facilities, 8 years), Valley Medical Centers (6 sites, 5 years).

files.name: GreenHealth Waste Services — Medical Waste Management Proposal.pdf
files.summary: GreenHealth Waste Services proposal for RFP-003 (Medical Waste Management). Annual cost $68K. National provider, 800+ healthcare clients. DOT-certified, EPA-compliant, zero-landfill sustainability program. 2x/week pickups, 6-hour emergency collection. Digital tracking portal. Pharmaceutical waste handled via PharmaCycle Inc. partnership. Carbon-neutral operations.
files.content_excerpt: Pricing: $68,000/year, all Northbridge facilities included. Service: 2x/week scheduled pickups, 6-hour emergency collection. Fleet: DOT-certified, EPA-compliant, zero-landfill processing. Pharmaceutical waste: handled through PharmaCycle Inc. partnership (DEA-compliant third-party destruction).
